abilities.name: Quickcast
abilities.description: Allows spell caster to cast a single spell at twice the power cost to make it so that it cannot be interrupted by melee or spells. The only exception to this is the Necromancer form of Quickcast (Facilitate Painworking). It allows the Necromancer's summoned undead pet to have six seconds of uninterrupted casting time.
